code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if g[0][c] != 0 and all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    def bands(size, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < size:
            out.append((start, size))
        return out
    rows = bands(h, row_cuts)
    cols = bands(w, col_cuts)
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        for j in range(0, len(cols) - 1, 2):
            c0, c1 = cols[j]
            d0, d1 = cols[j + 1]
            if c1 - c0 != d1 - d0 or r1 - r0 != rows[rows.index((r0, r1))][1] - rows[rows.index((r0, r1))][0]:
                continue
            left = any(g[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            right = any(g[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(d0, d1))
            if left == right:
                continue
            src0, dst0 = (c0, d0) if left else (d0, c0)
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for x in range(c1 - c0):
                    g[r][dst0 + x] = g[r][src0 + (c1 - c0 - 1 - x)]
    return g
'''
